definitions: An ancient city-state in Greece, located on the Isthmus of Corinth.
A modern city in Greece, near the site of the ancient city.
A book of the New Testament, specifically either First Corinthians or Second Corinthians, epistles written by Paul to the church in Corinth.
examples: Ancient Corinth was a powerful trading center.
The Apostle Paul wrote letters to the church at Corinth.
We visited Corinth on our trip to Greece.
